LightningComponentBundle.description: Aggregated activity timeline showing Tasks, Events, Emails, SMS/Web, calls, messaging sessions, chats, Orders, Cases, Opportunities, Quotes, Contracts, Visits, Files, Chatter posts and Survey responses for an Account or Contact.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls card title, filter panel, type/date labels, empty state, action buttons and group headings. Uses Intl for date formatting.

property.name: excludeRelatedContacts
property.label: Exclude related-contact activities
property.description: Default: unchecked (related contacts included). Check to scope strictly to the current record.

property.name: enabledActionsCsv
property.label: Quick actions (CSV of API names)
property.description: Standard quick-action API names triggered from the toolbar. Adjust to match actions available on the object's page layout.

property.name: initialLimit
property.label: Initial items to display
property.description: Max total items shown (upcoming + past combined) before the 'Show more' button appears.

property.name: defaultEnabledTypesCsv
property.label: Default enabled activity types (CSV of keys)
property.description: Comma-separated list of type keys enabled by default. Empty = all. Keys: Task, Event, Email, EmailMessage, ListEmail, Call, VoiceCall, MessagingSession, LiveChatTranscript, Cadence, Order, Case, Opportunity, Quote, Contract, Visit, File, FeedItem, SurveyResponse.
